U.S. Bitcoin, Ether ETFs See $520 Million Combined Outflow as BlackRock ETHA Leads Redemptions U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $296 million in net outflows on Sept. 16, while spot Ether ETFs saw another $224 million leave, bringing combined daily outflows across the two categories to about $520 million. Morgan Stanley’s MSBT bucked the broader Bitcoin ETF trend with $3.47 million in net inflows, while BlackRock’s ETHA posted the largest Ether ETF redemption of the day at $110 million. — link

Russia’s Largest Stock Exchange MOEX to Launch Crypto Perpetual Futures on BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP and TRX Moscow Exchange (MOEX), Russia’s largest stock exchange, will launch perpetual futures linked to its BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP and TRX indices on September 22. The contracts will be available only to qualified investors, quoted in U.S. dollars and settled in Russian rubles without delivery of the underlying crypto assets. MOEX said more than 72,000 qualified investors have traded its crypto-linked futures since the first products launched last summer, with cumulative trading volume exceeding RUB 600 billion. — link

Highlight Clip: Bybit CEO : We Actually Gave Every Employee an AI Agent Bybit CEO : We Actually Gave Every Employee an AI Agent On April 15, 2026, Bybit co-founder and CEO Ben Zhou said in a Cointelegraph interview at Paris Blockchain Week that Bybit has given every employee an AI agent with access to the same information as the employee. He said AI can help companies retain knowledge that would otherwise be lost when employees leave, allowing the agent to stay with the role rather than the individual. Meanwhile, AI can also handle repetitive tasks such as entering client information and finding documents, improving internal efficiency. — link

Only 290 People Worldwide Hold $100 Million or More in Crypto, Henley Says An estimated 290 people worldwide hold at least $100 million in crypto assets, according to Henley & Partners’ Crypto Wealth Report 2026, which combines on-chain data, public information and wealth-model estimates. As of Aug. 31, the report estimates 135,694 crypto millionaires, including 92,272 with at least $1 million in Bitcoin, while the global crypto-holder population has reached roughly 742 million, about half of whom own Bitcoin. Henley’s 2026 Crypto Adoption Index ranked Singapore No. 1 for a fourth straight year, followed by the UAE, Hong Kong, the U.S. and Switzerland. — link
